scope: Public-package OFFLINE reproduction only; zero new model API calls; not an online rerun.

author_unit_tests.category: one self_test subprocess; not 38 product runs

public_inputs.canonical_hash_encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps(filtered final-03 inputs, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)); original sorted input order

coverage.scope: selected individually locatable invocation/batch receipts, not exhaustive historical totals
coverage.self_test: 3 historical standalone logs +1 supplemented failed engine invocation +3 raw-captured passing invocations(32/35/38 assertions); additional imported selftests counted by their own event IDs
coverage.offline_recompute: 5 separately identified result batches including archived10-27 replay; not each result row
coverage.grading_regression: 2 archived and 1 fresh lead invocation, nested selftests not additional events
coverage.interface_preflight: one external WB sandbox preflight reference, not public verified evidence
coverage.product_run: 91 canonical tool/product executions in ledger, including invalid/research; exploratory-probe uses product tools and is not bare model
coverage.excluded: source scans, syntax checks, future reviewer validation and subsequent unregistered invocations not silently counted
coverage.original_times: retain explicit receipt timestamps/verbatim time lines; generated_at/date not automatically runtime; unknown if no explicit field
coverage.imported_events: build-recipe pins exact imported envelopes; their source collection times are preserved per event, not inferred from batch names

failure_history.cause: First probe incorrectly expected socket construction itself to fail; corrected to network connect.
Reviewer positive file-read probe used root AGENTS.md, which is not git-tracked/copied; corrected to explicitly copied checks script. No implementation executed.

Reviewer synthetic bird denominator was 10 instead of 15 (2 failures); reviewer incorrectly assumed large/full stdout tool_result was complete instead of an exact 8192-character CLI prefix (2 failures). Implementation and frozen sources were unchanged.

CLI stdout displays only first 8192 characters for two large/full tool results; full request and deterministic source/tool-output/process SHA are independently checked.
